cards.card_text: "You have said it yourself," He answers, and He tells them all that from now on they will see the Son of Man, the name Jesus uses for Himself (Mark 2:10), sitting at the right hand of Power and coming on the clouds of heaven.
cards.verse_text: “You have said it yourself,” Jesus answered. “But I say to all of you, from now on you will see the Son of Man sitting at the right hand of Power and coming on the clouds of heaven.”

cards.card_text: After all that silence, Jesus answers, “I am.” And He's not done: “and you will see the Son of Man sitting at the right hand of Power and coming with the clouds of heaven.”
cards.verse_text: “I am,” said Jesus, “and you will see the Son of Man sitting at the right hand of Power and coming with the clouds of heaven.”
